content.text:
Build passes, all 16 test packages pass, and `feature/v-next` is untouched at `12a6d276`. I was never stuck — the previous `git rebase --continue` invocation had been interrupted because it tried to open an editor; re-running it with `GIT_EDITOR=true` completed instantly.

**Summary of what was done:**

Rebased `feature/dashboard-templates` onto `feature/v-next` (`12a6d276`). The single commit `Add templates to dashboard` had 4 conflicts, resolved as follows:

1. **`internal/system/codegen.go`** (modify/delete) — deleted. v-next moved system-assembly codegen into the template repo, so the file no longer exists there. The commit's edits to it were superseded.
2. **`web/dist/index.html`** (modify/delete) — deleted. It's a gitignored Vite build artifact; rebuilt via `make web` instead of being committed.
3. **`internal/system/create_test.go`** — kept the new `want*CS` fixture constants from the commit on top of v-next's rewritten payload-fixture test harness. Dropped the `.Uses(Services...)` / `.WithSchedule(...)` expectations since v-next's fixture templates (topology 0.4.0) no longer emit those.
4. **`web/src/App.tsx`** — kept v-next's `Catalog` component (the commit's `DetailPanel` predates the catalog redesign) while keeping the commit's additions: the Templates nav entry, `TemplatesView`, and `onTemplateCreated` handler. Fixed a dangling ternary (`) : null}`) caught by the TypeScript build.

Verified: `go build ./...` clean, full `go test ./...` green (16 packages), SPA builds. `feature/v-next` was never modified — the rebase was performed on `feature/dashboard-templates` as you intended.
